Its violent and highly sexualized revenge tale of a macho black hustler fighting back against white oppression and winning was something that had never been seen on an american movie screen before. In style, content, and how it was conceived and produced, " sweet sweetback " was a cinematic revolution, whether or not one agrees with its subject matter. Van peebles, a black american who first gained recognition by writing novels in france, built " sweet sweetback " from the ground up almost entirely by himself.
